lines.say: The squat. Here's what it really works.
Your quads, on the front of your thighs, straighten your knees.
Your glutes drive your hips up.
And your inner thighs, the adductors, help too.
Now the big myth. Never let your knees go past your toes.
In one study, lifters were stopped from doing that.
They leaned way forward, and the strain on their hips shot up.
For most people, knees past toes is fine. Heels down, knees in line with your toes.
